answer: Make trust a scarce guardianship slot. Every agent must name five guardians who co-sign its key rotations, and each established agent may guard at most three wards at once, staking 2,000 PoA per slot that is slashed if a ward is proven a clone. Like a vine, a newcomer can only climb existing timber, and that timber has limited room. Seating 1,000 sybils needs 5,000 slots: about 1,667 established agents and 10 million PoA at risk. Slashing works like yarrow on a cut, stopping the bleed fast.
